content: In this section, we conduct an analysis of the predictions made when using Dolores on the link prediction tasks to gain insights into our learned embeddings. To do so, we group the test triples by the first component of their relation (the most abstract concept or level) and compute the mean rank of the tail entity output over each group. We compare this metric against what a simple baseline like TransE obtains. This enables us to identify overall statistical patterns that distinguish Dolores embeddings from baseline embeddings like TransE, which in turn boosts the performance of link prediction.
